ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened modestly higher, with Bitcoin and Ethereum gaining around 0.6‑0.7% and altcoins like Solana, XRP and Dogecoin posting stronger gains. The positive momentum is supported by fresh ETF inflows and new token listings on Delta India, though a pending banking lawsuit and upcoming election could introduce volatility.
